text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu, who decided to run in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). In that race—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Never in my wildest dreams did I think 
I'd be facing you on the turf."

Sirius Symboli. The Symboli family 
Umamusume who won the Nippon Derby the 
year before last. Lately, she's been 
showing a bold, challenging spirit, not 
limiting herself to domestic races.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I heard the young lady was going to make a 
spectacular exit, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: However, she's right in front of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you still think this is a dream, I 
wouldn't mind showing you the truth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
By the feeling of my knees hitting the 
dirt.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. Quite the instigator, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're up to something interesting right 
now, aren't you? Something about dragging 
that "Emperor" out into the open.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Being so obsessed with such an uptight 
stick-in-the-mud is beyond terrible taste. 
More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Choose me instead. I'll dote on you way 
better than her, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Too bad. I'm not a trophy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Don't look so uneasy. I'm plenty 
interested in you, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"For someone who knows the world, I trust 
your flavor isn't on the bland side?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder, can you truly take me in?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Whether you finish it all is up 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it doesn't taste good, that's all it 
amounts to.
